independence: Models parse displayed JSON question inputs and never import the authors' calculation modules. Every question has a scientific/scope review and a full-record hash. Visual approval is stored by exact SVG hash; the verifier cannot approve new images.

scope.R1.1: Shared SL/HL: all content; calorimetry, heat direction, standard enthalpy and profiles
scope.R1.2: Shared: bond-enthalpy estimates and Hess manipulation. HL: formation/combustion standard-data sums and Born-Haber calculations; no full cycle construction required
scope.R1.3: Shared SL/HL: all content, including hydrogen/methanol fuel-cell half-equations; proton-exchange membrane detail excluded
scope.R1.4: HL only: entropy, Gibbs, spontaneity, Q and K
scope.R2.1: Shared SL/HL: all content; stoichiometry, limiting reactants, percentage yield, atom economy
scope.R2.2: Shared statements1-5: rates, collision theory, conditions, Maxwell-Boltzmann, catalysts. HL statements6-13: mechanisms, transition states, rate law, molecularity, Arrhenius and factor A
scope.R2.3: Shared statements1-4: dynamic equilibrium, K expression/magnitude/reversal and qualitative Le Chatelier. HL statements5-7: Q, composition calculation, small-K approximation, Gibbs link; quadratic solutions not expected

independentModels: Calorimetry: q(solution)=mcΔT, q(reaction)=-q(surroundings), ΔH=q(reaction)/reacting amount; include calorimeter heat where given
Bonds: ΣD(broken)-ΣD(formed), accounting for all stoichiometric bonds and gas-phase assumption
Hess: reverse changes sign; scale changes magnitude; cancel chemical species before adding energy
Formation: ΣνΔHf(products)-ΣνΔHf(reactants); combustion-data route uses reactant combustion minus product combustion
Born-Haber: explicit signed state path and lattice convention, including second ionization/electron affinity where required
Fuel metrics: complete/incomplete atom balance, energy per mass, CO2 per energy; fuel-cell half-equations balance atoms and charge in stated electrolyte
Entropy/Gibbs: ΔS products minus reactants; ΔG=ΔH-TΔS after J/kJ conversion; T in kelvin; spontaneous iff actual ΔG<0
Nonstandard thermodynamics: ΔG=ΔG°+RT lnQ; ΔG°=-RT lnK; actual ΔG=0 at equilibrium even if ΔG° is nonzero
Stoichiometry: reactant extent n/ν, limiting minimum, theoretical product, percentage yield and atom economy with the balanced formula
Rates: signed species change/time, tangent slopes, stoichiometric rate ratios, experimental order, k units and multistep barrier references
Arrhenius: ln(k2/k1)=Ea/R(1/T1-1/T2), ln k intercept=ln A, slope=-Ea/R
Equilibrium: K and Q exponents from balanced stoichiometry, pure phases excluded as appropriate, direction from Q versus K, extent and changing total volume handled explicitly
svgHelperReview: common.py emits explicit polygon arrowheads and escapes text content; no external references, marker URLs, active content or unsupported image embeds. Actual generated SVG fields require schema validation and visual inspection.
